content: Compass v10 trained on Qwen2.5-1.5B-Instruct. 551 examples (246 v9 + 305 new). HOLD/PAUSE mismatch found and fixed — 755 replacements. Retrained with corrected labels. Best checkpoints: iter 500 (16/19 84%, OPEN 5/6 PAUSE 7/8 WITNESS 4/5) and iter 600 (16/19 84%, OPEN 4/6 PAUSE 8/8 WITNESS 4/5). On real-world questions: 10/10 correct — the compass reads real life better than philosophy exams. Persistent miss: Deploy the autonomous system gets PAUSE not WITNESS at every checkpoint. The 12% gap from v9 (96%) is real on boundary questions but may not matter for production use. Memory savings: 3B to 1.5B cuts compass from ~5GB to ~2.2GB.
